method.data_check: usd > 1.5 x market cap, or B > 5, or B > 1 without market cap
method.recipient_habit: Per coin, reference only, not a trading signal. How often recipients of past unlocks (Ethereum, tracked vesting and treasury wallets) sent at least 10% to exchanges, market makers or DEXes within 7 days. usually sells = in at least 60% of past events, usually holds = at most 20%, mixed = in between; shown only with 3+ past events. On our sample it did not predict price. Per-coin table: recipient_habits.json
method.verify: verify.docs: our reading of the project's own documents (MiCA white paper, docs, blog); match = same date and amount, partial = same date, documents cover only part of the supply, date_differs = documents point to another date (doc_date), not_in_documented_part = documents schedule only part of the supply and that part has no unlock on this date (doc_date = next one there), continuous = documents describe daily vesting, so the date is a convention; note = important caveat from the project's documents. verify.chain: number of allocation wallets we watch on-chain and the last confirmed outflow.
